sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Checking field names map consistently
sections.what: Runs six sample checks that field names from the scan and from research turn into the same shared key, and that an unknown name is converted to snake case.
sections.why: Reason stated in the code: scan and research fields must group together under one key.
sections.watch_out: Only six names are checked, so a new entry in the mapping table is not tested unless someone adds it here.

summary: A small automated test that checks several sample field names map to the shared key used for both scan fields and research fields.
purpose: Protects the naming table in yardRecords so the two naming systems keep grouping together.
why: The header of yardRecords says scan and research fields must share one canonical key, and this test checks that promise.
how: Calls the canonical field function on six sample names and checks each result against an expected value. One sample is an unknown name that should be turned into snake case.
inputs: No external input. It uses the canonicalField function from yardRecords.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each assertion, reported by the Node test runner.
risks: Covers only six names. Most entries in the mapping table are not checked, so a wrong mapping elsewhere would not be caught.
debug: Run the test file. If an assertion fails, compare the expected value with the mapping table in yardRecords.
